text: Scaffold a new agent project with a single CLI command
quote: Mastra is a TypeScript framework for building AI agents and applications. Create your first agent with a single command and start building.

text: Route requests to 40+ LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.) through one interface
quote: Model routing: Connect to 40+ providers through one standard interface. Use models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and more.

text: Build autonomous agents that reason about goals and decide which tools to call
quote: Build autonomous agents that use LLMs and tools to solve open-ended tasks. Agents reason about goals, decide which tools to use, and iterate internally until the model emits a final answer or an optional stopping condition is met.

text: Graph-based workflow engine with .then()/.branch()/.parallel() control flow
quote: use Mastra's graph-based workflow engine to orchestrate complex multi-step processes. Mastra workflows use an intuitive syntax for control flow (`.then()`, `.branch()`, `.parallel()`).

text: Suspend an agent or workflow and resume later using persisted execution state
quote: Suspend an agent or workflow and await user input or approval before resuming. Mastra uses storage to remember execution state, so you can pause indefinitely and resume where you left off.

text: Define typed tools via createTool with id, description, input/output schemas and execute function
quote: Import `createTool` from `@mastra/core/tools` and define a tool with an `id`, `description`, `inputSchema`, `outputSchema`, and `execute` function.

text: Load tools from remote MCP servers to extend an agent's capabilities
quote: You can also load tools from remote MCP servers to expand an agent's capabilities.

text: Agent memory persists user messages, replies, and tool results across interactions
quote: Memory enables your agent to remember user messages and agent replies, and tool results across interactions, giving it the context it needs to stay consistent, maintain conversation flow, plus produce better answers over time.

text: Share a single conversation thread across multiple users
quote: Multi-user threads: Share one thread between multiple users.

text: Real-time incremental streaming of agent and workflow output
quote: Mastra supports real-time, incremental responses from agents and workflows, allowing users to see output as it's generated instead of waiting for completion.

text: Live evaluations automatically score AI outputs in real time as agents run
quote: Live evaluations allow you to automatically score AI outputs in real-time as your agents and workflows operate.

text: Observability system gives visibility into every agent run, workflow step, tool call, and model interaction
quote: Mastra's observability system gives you visibility into every agent run, workflow step, tool call, and model interaction.

text: Runs on Node.js, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare runtimes
quote: Mastra can run against any of these runtime environments: - Node.js `v22.13.0` or later - Bun - Deno - Cloudflare

text: Official MCP docs server gives coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, etc.) direct access to Mastra documentation
quote: The `@mastra/mcp-docs-server` package provides direct local access to Mastra's full documentation via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It works with Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex or any tool that supports MCP.

text: Self-host Mastra projects for free under Apache 2.0 license
quote: Self host your Mastra projects ... Free Apache 2.0 licensed $0/ month ... Build and host agents anywhere

text: Pause a workflow at any step to gather data, wait for a callback, or get human approval
quote: Pause a workflow at any step to collect additional data, wait for an API callback, throttle a costly operation, or request human-in-the-loop input.

text: Workflows define explicit multi-step task sequences instead of relying on agent reasoning alone
quote: Workflows let you define complex task sequences with clear, structured steps instead of relying on one agent to reason through the entire process.

text: Deploy Mastra apps to any Node.js-compatible environment, as a server or integrated into an existing web framework
quote: Mastra applications can be deployed to any Node.js-compatible environment. You can deploy a Mastra server or integrate with an existing web framework.

text: Author MCP servers to expose agents, tools, and structured resources
quote: Author Model Context Protocol servers, exposing agents, tools, and other structured resources via the MCP interface.

text: Compose workflow execution flow using createWorkflow steps
quote: Composing **steps** with `createWorkflow` to define the execution flow.

text: Enterprise access controls: RBAC, SSO, IAM, and network policy integration
quote: Enterprise controls RBAC, SSO, IAM, and network policy integration.

text: Convert Mastra streams and stored messages into AI SDK-compatible formats
quote: Use `toAISdkStream()` and `toAISdkMessages()` to convert Mastra streams and stored messages to AI SDK-compatible formats.

text: Packages ship embedded docs in dist/docs that an AI agent can read directly from node_modules
quote: Mastra packages come with embedded documentation in `dist/docs`. When you install a Mastra package, your AI agent can read these files directly from `node_modules` to understand the package's APIs and patterns.

text: Structured output lets an agent return a schema-shaped object instead of plain text
quote: Structured output lets an agent return an object that matches the shape defined by a schema instead of returning text.

text: Mark a tool with requireApproval to gate execution behind human approval in the stream
quote: Mark a tool with `requireApproval: true`, then check for the `tool-call-approval` chunk in the stream to approve or decline the action

text: PromptInjectionDetector scans user messages for prompt injection, jailbreak, and system override attempts
quote: The `PromptInjectionDetector()` scans user messages for prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, and system override patterns.

text: Processors transform, validate, or control messages as they pass through an agent
quote: Processors transform, validate, or control messages as they pass through an agent.

text: Code mode runs multi-tool computations in an isolated sandbox for more accurate single responses
quote: Code mode lets an agent run multi-tool computations in an isolated sandbox and return the result as a single, more accurate response.

text: Workflow state shares values across steps without threading them through every input/output schema
quote: Workflow state lets you share values across steps without passing them through every step's inputSchema and outputSchema.

text: Run workflow steps simultaneously using .parallel()
quote: Use `.parallel()` to run steps simultaneously.

text: Workflow steps can call agents for LLM reasoning or call tools for type-safe logic
quote: Workflow steps can call agents to use LLM reasoning or call tools for type-safe logic.

text: Dynamic workflows can be created by users, agents, or external systems without code changes or redeploys
quote: Use dynamic workflows when users, agents, visual editors, or external systems need to create workflows without changing application code or deploying again.

text: Snapshots capture all state needed to resume a workflow exactly where it left off
quote: Snapshots capture all the information needed to resume a workflow from exactly where it left off

text: Time travel lets you re-execute a workflow from any specific step using stored snapshots or custom context
quote: Time travel allows you to re-execute a workflow starting from any specific step, using either stored snapshot data or custom context you provide.

text: Declare a cron schedule field on a workflow to run it automatically
quote: Declare a `schedule` field on a workflow and Mastra will fire it on the cron you specify.

text: Events flow through PubSub so clients can disconnect and reconnect without losing stream chunks
quote: Events flow through PubSub, which means a client can disconnect and reconnect without missing chunks.

text: Background tasks let an agent dispatch long-running tool calls without blocking its agentic loop
quote: Background tasks let an agent dispatch a long-running tool call without blocking the agentic loop.

text: Goals are durable, thread-scoped objectives the agent keeps pursuing across loop iterations until satisfied
quote: A goal is a durable, thread-scoped objective: a standing instruction the agent keeps working toward across loop iterations until a judge model decides it's satisfied

text: Schedules run an agent automatically on a cron cadence
quote: A schedule runs an agent on a cron cadence.

text: Scorers evaluate agent outputs using model-graded, rule-based, and statistical methods
quote: Scorers are automated tests that evaluate Agents outputs using model-graded, rule-based, and statistical methods.

text: Local Studio UI (localhost:4111) lets you test agents and inspect their runs
quote: Open Studio at [`http://localhost:4111`](http://localhost:4111) to test your agent and inspect its runs.

text: suspend()/resume() APIs pause workflow execution at a step and restart it later
quote: Use suspend() to pause workflow execution at a specific step... Use resume() to restart a suspended workflow from the step where it paused.

text: Hosted Studio provides a visual environment for testing agents, running workflows, and inspecting traces
quote: Studio: A hosted visual environment for testing agents and running workflows, plus inspecting traces

text: Predictable enterprise pricing: one flat annual fee instead of per-trace or per-seat metering
quote: Enterprise controls RBAC, SSO, IAM, and network policy integration... Predictable cost One flat annual fee — no per-trace or per-seat metering.
